faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: SkillBank is a 'skill banking' platform that allows users to share, exchange, and collaborate based on their skills to execute projects.
faq.q2: 2. Is there a fee to create an account on SkillBank?
faq.a2: No. Registration and account creation are completely free. Advanced features (if any) will be clearly announced later.
faq.q3: 3. How can I post my skills?
faq.a3: Simply go to your profile page, select 'Add Skill', provide a detailed description and proficiency level.
faq.q4: 4. How do I find the right person to support my project?
faq.a4: You can use the skill-based search function, filter by experience level, or post a project request for the community to see.
faq.q5: 5. How many projects can I join at the same time?
faq.a5: There is no specific limit. However, SkillBank encourages you to join only a suitable number to ensure work quality.
faq.a6: Each skill has a corresponding exchange value agreed upon by the community or suggested by the system. Both parties can agree before collaborating.
faq.q7: 7. Can I rate someone who helped me?
faq.a7: Yes. After project completion, you can rate satisfaction level and quality of contribution from team members.
faq.q8: 8. Does SkillBank ensure the safety of personal information?
faq.a8: Yes. We implement security measures to protect user data and commit to not sharing information without authorization.
faq.q9: 9. Can I edit or delete posted skills?
faq.a9: Absolutely. You can update, edit, or delete any skill anytime in your profile section.
faq.q10: 10. Where can I contact if I encounter errors or need support?
faq.a10: You can submit requests through 'Technical Support', contact customer care email, or chat directly with SkillBank's support team.

home.heroTitle:
The Skill Bank 
Turn Ideas Into Reality
home.heroSubtitle: Got an idea but lack the skills? Don't let money stop you. At SkillBank, we exchange skills for skills to build real products together.
home.ctaTitle: Don't let your ideas stay on paper
home.ctaSubtitle: Join the SkillBank community today. Use your skills to 'pay' for the missing pieces of your dream project.
home.faq1_a: It's simple: You 'borrow' the skills you lack and 'repay' with the skills you have. E.g., You code but need a logo? Find a Designer who needs a website and collaborate.
home.faq2_q: Do I have to pay money?
home.faq2_a: Absolutely not. At SkillBank, the only currencies are Skills and Time. We remove financial barriers so you can focus on creating.
home.faq3_a: Not exactly. This is a place for students to build real products (Pet Projects, MVPs) together to learn and enhance their Portfolios.
